settings.animations.preview.tooltip: Click during the animation to reverse it
settings.animations.style.title: Animation style
settings.animations.style.modern.descrip: A smooth “lamp” curve from Potassiumuncher's engine, drawn on the graphics card.
settings.animations.style.classic.descri: The original funnel effect from the first version of the mod, fading out at the end.
settings.animations.duration.title: Duration
settings.animations.duration.description: How long a window takes to fall into the taskbar and to come back.
settings.animations.mesh.title: Mesh quality
settings.animations.mesh.description: More tiles make a smoother curve (modern style). On the graphics card the cost is negligible.
settings.animations.open.title: Opening
settings.animations.open.genie.descripti: The window flies out of the program's taskbar icon with the genie effect.
settings.animations.openDuration.title: Opening duration
settings.animations.openDuration.descrip: How long a window takes to fly out of the taskbar.
settings.animations.close.title: Closing
settings.animations.close.genie.descript: The window falls into its taskbar icon with the genie effect.
settings.animations.closeDuration.title: Closing duration
settings.animations.closeDuration.descri: How long a closing window takes to fall into the taskbar.
settings.animations.openClose.note: Works in programs MacWin has access to. With “Windows”, the window behaves as it would without MacWin.
settings.animations.restore.title: Restoring windows
settings.animations.restore.description: The window flies out of the taskbar back to where it was.
settings.animations.multiMonitor.title: Multiple monitors
settings.animations.multiMonitor.descrip: Experimental: the genie goes to the taskbar on the window's monitor instead of the main one.
settings.animations.unhide.title: Show the taskbar while minimizing
settings.animations.unhide.description: A hidden taskbar slides out so the window has somewhere to go.
settings.animations.unhideDuration.title: How long the taskbar stays visible
settings.animations.instant.note: Changes take effect immediately – there is nothing to save or restart.
settings.animations.notRunning: MacWin is not running. Start it on the “General” page.
settings.corners.shape.title: Window corners
settings.corners.shape.description: macOS: a squircle with 100% smoothing, as in Figma. Windows 11: a plain rounded corner. Maximized and full-screen windows always have square corners.
settings.corners.radius.title: Corner radius
settings.corners.radius.description: At 100% scaling; MacWin adjusts it to the display scale. 0 px means square corners.
settings.corners.genie.title: Animations and the settings window
settings.corners.genie.description: The window in the genie animation and this window always have these corners.
settings.corners.others.title: Other programs' windows
settings.corners.others.description: Programs that draw their own title bar: Chrome, Brave, Edge, Discord, VS Code, Spotify, Claude. MacWin adds a shadow and a smoothed edge. Windows with the system title bar (File Explorer, Notepad) keep the Windows 11 corners – changing their shape breaks the frame.
settings.general.enabled.title: Animations on
settings.general.enabled.description: The main switch. Off means the standard Windows animations.
settings.general.autostart.title: Start with Windows
settings.general.autostart.description: MacWin starts when you sign in and stays in the notification area.
settings.general.autostart.description.i: MacWin starts when you sign in – with administrator rights, without a UAC prompt – and stays in the notification area.
settings.general.language.title: Language
settings.general.language.description: “Automatic” follows the Windows display language. Languages MacWin doesn't have yet fall back to English.
settings.general.status.title: Status
settings.general.status.elevated: Running with administrator rights – programs started as administrator are animated too.
settings.general.status.normal: Running without administrator rights – programs started as administrator keep the standard animations.
settings.general.updates.check.title: Check for updates automatically
settings.general.updates.check.descripti: Once a day MacWin asks GitHub whether a new version is out. Nothing else is sent.
settings.general.updates.auto.title: Install updates automatically
settings.general.updates.auto.descriptio: New versions are downloaded and installed in the background. When off, you get a notification and install with one click.
settings.general.updates.status.failed: Couldn't check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
settings.general.updates.status.hostStop: Start MacWin to check for updates.
settings.general.testMode.title: Only selected programs
settings.general.testMode.description: MacWin works only in the programs on the list below. Turn it off to animate every program.
settings.general.footnote: Programs that were open before you changed this list must be closed and opened again. If anything misbehaves, Ctrl+Alt+Shift+F12 turns MacWin off immediately.
settings.exclusions.noAnimation.descript: Windows of these programs minimize with the standard Windows animation. Takes effect immediately.
settings.exclusions.noInject.description: MacWin never enters these programs – for example games with anti-cheat protection that dislike foreign libraries. A folder works too, e.g. \steamapps\common\. Takes effect after the program is restarted.
settings.list.dialog.title: Choose a program
settings.about.author: Created by {0}
settings.about.github.title: Source code
settings.about.github.description: MacWin is open source. Stars, ideas and contributions are welcome.
settings.about.changelog.title: What's new
settings.about.reportBug.title: Report a problem
settings.about.reportBug.description: Describe what happened and attach the log – it helps a lot.
settings.about.license.title: License
settings.about.license.description: GNU GPL v3.0 or later. When you share MacWin or a modified version, keep the author's name.
settings.about.genie.title: Genie animation
settings.about.genie.description: Based on the Windhawk mod “MacOS Minimize Animation” by Abdullah Masood, with Potassiumuncher's engine. MIT license.
settings.about.minhook.description: Function hooking library by Tsuda Kageyu. BSD 2-Clause license.
settings.about.log.title: Activity log
settings.about.log.description: What MacWin does: animations, frame times, errors.
settings.about.folder.title: Settings folder
settings.about.folder.description: settings.json – the same things you change in this window.
settings.widgets.desktop.empty: No widgets yet. Click one above to put it on the desktop.
settings.widgets.notes.placeholder: Write your note here. The first line is its title.
settings.widgets.photo.dialog.title: Choose a photo
settings.widgets.show.title: Show widgets on the desktop
settings.widgets.show.description: Drag a widget to move it. Right-click it to change its size or look.
settings.widgets.scale.title: Size
settings.widgets.scale.description: Makes every widget bigger or smaller.
settings.widgets.seconds.title: Second hand
settings.widgets.seconds.description: The clock ticks every second. Without it, it changes once a minute.
settings.widgets.location.title: Use my location
settings.widgets.location.description: The weather where this PC is, from Windows location services.
settings.widgets.location.denied: Windows doesn’t share the location with MacWin. Turn it on in Windows, or choose a place below.
settings.widgets.location.unavailable: Windows couldn’t find the location just now. Until it can, the place below is used.
settings.widgets.location.rough: Windows only knows roughly where this PC is. For the right town, choose it below or set your default location in Windows.
settings.widgets.place.title: Place
settings.widgets.place.fallbackNone: Used when your location isn’t known
settings.widgets.place.error: The search didn't work. Check the internet connection.
settings.widgets.units.title: Temperature
settings.widgets.footnote: The weather comes from Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) and the town’s name from OpenStreetMap (nominatim.openstreetmap.org). While a Weather widget is on the desktop, MacWin sends them the place’s coordinates, rounded to about a kilometre, every 30 minutes (OpenStreetMap only when the PC has moved); a search sends the name you type. Nothing else leaves your computer.
host.menu.testMode: Test mode (only programs on the list)
host.error.sharedSettings: MacWin can't create its shared settings. If it was running with administrator rights a moment ago, sign out and sign in again.
host.error.renderer: MacWin can't start its renderer (Direct3D 11 / DirectComposition). The details are in the log.
host.error.hookDll: MacWin can't load MacWinHook64.dll. The details are in the log.
host.error.elevatedOutside:
MacWin can run with administrator rights only from the Program Files folder (after installation). From this folder any program could replace MacWinHook64.dll and get into programs started as administrator.

Start MacWin without administrator rights or install it with the installer.
